models.description: Union Alpha through OpenRouter (`stealth/union-alpha`). OpenRouter publishes a 262,144-token window, 131,072-token output limit, text and image input, and currently prices it at zero. Codex compact reserves that output budget. OpenRouter does not advertise a reasoning-effort parameter, so the stored single high level is this repository's conservative default. Its endpoint record accepts tool_choice auto only.
models.availabilityNux: Union Alpha is now on OpenRouter as stealth/union-alpha. Access is currently free for a limited time.
